messages.content: Read only the current facts and question and return every coherent factual view. Extract annual income records, directed marriage records, actual joint or separate return statements, and explicit positive or negative section 151 allowance givens. A section 151(b) record is taxpayer-to-spouse and a section 151(c) record is taxpayer-to-dependent; preserve polarity and never use the target section 63 query as its own given. Use a subtype only when the text and witnessed factual role support it; otherwise mark the channel unread or provide separate coherent views. Represent 'has been married since D' as ongoing_since, a bare commencement as onset_only, and an expressly bounded marriage as closed_interval. For every channel, complete means the entire finite supplied text was inspected, so [] means no matching statement; unread or failed is not an empty negative. Attach exact nonempty current witnesses. Do not calculate the deduction limit or provide a native answer.
